purpose: Teach: 名声/攻める/前身/模試/近世/廃案/本州/鎖国

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、名声ある専門医、近年、地方にも増えました。
lines.en: Ren, well-regarded specialists have been appearing more frequently in regional areas in recent years.
lines.style: Clear, measured delivery. Opening with his name acknowledges him directly. Steady pace, informative but not lecturing. Slight emphasis on 'regional' — noting a trend she's observed.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 治療、攻める方針と、保守的方針、両論あるんですね。
lines.en: So there are different schools of thought — aggressive treatment versus a more conservative approach.
lines.style: Leaning forward slightly with interest. Genuine curiosity, not performing knowledge. Soft upward inflection on the question. Processing what she's said.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。当院の前身、明治の診療所です。
lines.en: Yes. This hospital traces back to a Meiji-era clinic — our predecessor.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, grounded in institutional history. Slight pause after 'Yes' — she's anchoring the conversation in what she knows. Calm authority without weight.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医学生、模試で、実力測りますか。
lines.en: Do medical students take mock exams to assess their level?
lines.style: Hesitant phrasing, testing whether this is a reasonable question. Respectful but earnest. No performance — he's genuinely trying to understand how preparation works.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。近世の医療史、教養として大切です。
lines.en: Yes. Early-modern medical history is an important part of their foundational education.
lines.style: Slightly warmer than before — she recognizes the genuine question. Clear, direct. A small affirmation that he's on the right track. Educational but not condescending.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 承認、廃案になった薬、ありましたね。
lines.en: There have been drugs that were rejected in the approval process.
lines.style: Tentative, testing whether he's asking the right thing. Quiet confidence underneath — she knows this territory. Slight trailing-off, inviting him to push further.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。本州医療連携、強化中です。
lines.en: Yes. We're currently strengthening our medical coordination network across Honshu.
lines.style: Shift to procedural clarity. More structured, less personal. She's moving into institutional context — this is how systems work now. Steady, factual.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 鎖国期の医療制限、現代との対比、研究、興味深いですね。
lines.en: The medical restrictions during the Sakoku period compared to modern practice — that's genuinely fascinating research.
lines.style: Soft, almost surprised recognition. He's arrived somewhere real. Slow, contemplative pace. This lands differently than the earlier questions. A small smile in the voice.
